end.summary:
Practised naming small animals found in soil and leaf litter; naming is still building.
Practised how earthworm tunnels let in air and water and how soil animals turn dead leaves into rich soil; this needs more checking next time.
Pihu first said earthworms are insects, then corrected this after noticing they have no legs.
Pihu continued to say earthworms spoil soil and should be removed; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised soil animals with Pihu, including ants and earthworms, and used their body features to discuss whether an animal is an insect. Pihu corrected the earthworm-insect mix-up during the lesson, but the idea that earthworms harm soil remained and needs revisiting. At home, look at a picture or safe garden observation together and ask Pihu to say one way earthworms help soil; avoid harming them.
